sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.135/2022 dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Karahi, Dist. Khargone for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 342, 376, 376(2)(N), 376(3) of IPC and 3/4, 5L/6 of POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(va), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.
2. It is alleged that the applicant has abducted the minor girl and committed rape.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the statement of the prosecutrix and her parents have been recorded.
They have not supported the prosecution case.
